Task complete. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

**`projects/test-handoffs/output/2026-04-01-url-shortener-api/`**

- `app/main.py` — FastAPI app with all 4 endpoints: `POST /shorten`, `GET /{code}` (redirect), `DELETE /{code}`, `GET /{code}/stats`
- `app/models.py` — SQLAlchemy models: `Link` and `Click` (with referrer + user-agent tracking)
- `app/crud.py` — DB operations (create, lookup, record click, delete)
- `app/database.py` — SQLite by default; Postgres via `DATABASE_URL` env var (compatible with dag's docker-compose)
- `app/schemas.py` — Pydantic request/response schemas
- `app/utils.py` — 7-char alphanumeric code generation (aligns with bjorn's base-62 spec)
- `tests/test_api.py` — 9 tests covering all endpoints and edge cases; all pass

The `app.main:app` entrypoint matches dag's Dockerfile assumption. Two items from bjorn's architecture spec are deferred: Redis read-through cache and the `api_keys` table (not required by this task's scope).
